definitions.gloss: valvular heart disease; heart valve disease
definitions.explanation: Any disorder of the heart's valves in which they fail to open or close properly. Most often the full phrase is {心臓弁膜症|しんぞうべんまくしょう}, but {弁膜症|べんまくしょう} alone is common.

examples.japanese: {父|ちち}は{弁膜症|べんまくしょう}と{診断|しんだん}された。
examples.english: My father was diagnosed with valvular heart disease.

examples.japanese: {弁膜症|べんまくしょう}は{加齢|かれい}とともに{増|ふ}える。
examples.english: Valvular heart disease increases with age.

examples.japanese: {重度|じゅうど}の{弁膜症|べんまくしょう}には{手術|しゅじゅつ}が{必要|ひつよう}になることもある。
examples.english: Severe valvular heart disease can require surgery.

notes:
Compound of {弁膜|べんまく} (membrane valve) + {症|しょう} (disease, ailment). The {症|しょう} suffix is widely used to form names of medical conditions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {心臓|しんぞう}{弁膜症|べんまくしょう}: heart valve disease (full medical term)
- {弁膜症|べんまくしょう}{手術|しゅじゅつ}: valve surgery
- {僧帽弁|そうぼうべん}{閉鎖不全症|へいさふぜんしょう}: mitral regurgitation (a specific form)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {不整脈|ふせいみゃく}: arrhythmia — irregular heartbeat, a different kind of heart condition
- {心筋梗塞|しんきんこうそく}: heart attack — sudden blockage, distinct from chronic valve disease
